title: Automatic Map Configuration from Attribute Profiles
description: A Python library that proposes the first configuration of a web map of a research dataset from the profiles of its columns: the column that gives the title of each record, the field of the colours, the filters, the charts, the fields shown for a record and clustering. It computes the profiles from plain records and reads column names and headers in English and Greek.
